note: ROS 1 vs ROS 2 on the same physical robot. The robot was moved by the operator between runs (lifted onto a box for safety), so scene-dependent numbers such as the number of no-return samples are NOT comparable across these two captures.

scan.verdict: rate 14.059 vs 13.999 Hz (0.4%), 1440 samples both, frame lidar_link both, angle bounds/increment/range limits identical within print precision, scan_time and time_increment identical

tf.verdict: identical: xyz (0,0,0.14114), rpy (0.02618,0,0). ROS 2 reaches this value from the robot model; ROS 1 from its own URDF.

odom.verdict: BLOCKED: the motor board stopped sending telemetry after a runaway during the ROS 1 motion tests, so ROS 2 odometry, TF odom->base_link, localization and mapping could not be measured. Interface differs by design (PoseWithCovarianceStamped vs Odometry); ROS 2 also publishes openmover/localization/odom_legacy as nav_msgs/Odometry.

safety.ros2: two-factor actuation gate (parameter + CAASI_MOTOR_ACTUATION) and a 0.5 s command watchdog
